title: ARCH↔ML-001: Tensor-Arena Budget + On-Device Latency Budget
description: Architect supplies tensor-arena/footprint budget, latency/throughput deadline, target operator-support constraints, and the edge-vs-cloud inference split; Edge AI/ML returns actual model footprint, on-target latency, operator-coverage gaps, and accuracy-vs-resource trade-offs. Grounded in EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_ARCHITECT_SKILL §6.4.

budget.description: ARCH→ML: resource and timing budget for on-device inference.

inference_latency_deadline_ms.description: On-device inference latency deadline in ms.

supported_operators.description: Target operator-support constraints (TFLite Micro / CMSIS-NN kernels available).

measured_latency_ms.description: Measured on-target inference latency in ms.

operator_coverage_gaps.description: Operators not covered by the target runtime.

within_budget.description: True only if measured arena/flash/latency all fit the budget.

adr_ref.description: Required when within_budget = false (budget exceedance must be raised as an ADR — never silently traded).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Resource-budget allocation is an architectural NFR crossing role boundaries (ARB-governed). A budget exceedance accepted as a trade is a STRATEGIC ADR (Tier-1).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (budget definition at planning; arena-sizing validation as models mature; pre-integration latency sign-off)
confirm_conditions: budget carries tensor_arena_budget_kb, model_flash_budget_kb, inference_latency_deadline_ms (all with units) and an inference_split
model_actuals.within_budget = true with measured arena ≤ budget, flash ≤ budget, latency ≤ deadline
operator_coverage_gaps empty, or each gap has a documented mitigation
accuracy_pct reported honestly against the target
reject_conditions: within_budget = false without an adr_ref (silent budget trade forbidden, §3.10 / §6.5)
any budget or measurement emitted without a unit or as TBD
operator_coverage_gaps non-empty presented as a clean fit
counter_conditions: measured value marginally over budget and tolerance bands not yet ratified (CLAUDE.md §6.5) — request the Architect confirm the budget-trade ADR
edge-vs-cloud split contested — request a joint latency/energy trade study before sign-off
